item.title: TTT 397: Quiet On The Set!
item.description:
In this Canadian Thanksgiving themed episode, Eric annoys Rachelle with sound effects; a smartphone app that takes the fun out of consent; and underwear for germaphobes who like to get it on. Good times all around.

We are Calgary’s only Podcast.
